results.title: X.400
results.snippet: X.400 is a suite of ITU-T recommendations that define the ITU-T Message Handling System (MHS).At one time, the designers of X.400 expected it to be the predominant form of email, but this role has been taken by SMTP-based Internet e-mail. Despite this, it has been widely used within organizations and was a core part of Microsoft Exchange Server until 2006; variants continue to be important in military and aviation contexts.
